subject: Planting 18, 579
fact: The events of the repast for the ogre unfold on Planting 18, 579, beginning with the group's descent into the moathouse and culminating in the discovery of prisoners, zombies, and the Ogre's lair.
source_quote: Date: Planting 18, 579

subject: moathouse
fact: The moathouse contains a great hall, staircase, lower levels, prison doors, a storeroom, an eastern door, a southern hallway with three pillars, five rotting prison doors, and a tower near Emiry Meadows.
source_quote: There is no doubt that some evil powers are here. And I will defeat them! But first, a brief rest. It’s essential to rest when facing monsters. Back in Verbobonc, one of the trainers argued that rest, not activity, builds strength.

subject: southern hallway
fact: The southern hallway is 50 feet long, runs north-south, has three pillars 20 feet apart, a passageway leading east, and five rotten prison doors on the western wall.
source_quote: The hallway is 50 feet long and runs north-south. Three pillars are 20 feet apart, and a passageway leads east. Five doors are on the western wall. They look like they haven’t been opened in a long time. Something like prison doors designed to keep people in.

subject: ogre's nest
fact: The ogre's nest is in the corner of the eastern storeroom and contains a magical cloak of elvenkind.
source_quote: I look inside the Ogre’s nest and discover a magical cloak of elvenkind.

subject: magical cloak of elvenkind
fact: A magical cloak of elvenkind was found in the ogre's nest, indicating prior presence of an elf.
source_quote: I look inside the Ogre’s nest and discover a magical cloak of elvenkind.

subject: ring
fact: The gnome spy Jarran hands the party a ring upon their return to Hommlet.
source_quote: The gnome is still sitting there and hands us a ring.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer is a cleric who frequently overreacts, claims authority through wisdom and perception, and accidentally triggers hostile reactions with his actions, such as squealing at slime and nearly dying repeatedly.
source_quote: Calmer brags about how he can see everything. And then a blob of green slime lands on him. And he starts squealing.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr is a pragmatic, sarcastic companion who carries wood, removes slime with it, mocks Calmer, and is willing to lead despite Calmer’s claims.
source_quote: Using some wood I happened to be carrying on me, I removed the slime from his armor. Unfortunately, the slime ate through it.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia is a decisive, action-oriented member who insists on exploring unvisited areas, leads investigations into the southern hallway, and is the first to identify zombies and their origins.
source_quote: Let’s check that hallway to the south we ignored last time, guys.

subject: Zinia
fact: Zinia is a focused, skeptical leader who enters dangerous areas first, dismisses social distractions, and is the one who notices the smoke mephit and the summoning circle in the tower.
source_quote: Straws are drawn, and I am going to enter first. The mage is as far back as possible. Looking inside, I see permanent markings on the floor for a summoning circle and mural.

subject: Jarran
fact: Jarran is a gnome spy sent by the merchants of Lotrimil to investigate brigands, captured and imprisoned, who offers to join the party if they promise to keep exploring.
source_quote: My name is Jarran. I was sent out here by the merchants of Lotrimil to investigate the brigands attacking this area. I didn’t expect to get caught and put in this pantry room. I have a mission. And I need to get back to it. Although, if you need another sword and promise to keep exploring, I could stick around.

subject: Derrick
fact: Derrick is a merchant captured by brigands, brought to the moathouse as a repast for the ogre, and identifies other victims including Eltograph the Elf.
source_quote: My name is Derrick, and this is Florian. We’re originally from Norwell. Brigands captured us along the road to Hommlet. Those captured alive were brought here as a repast for the Ogre. There were six of us. Every day, the Ogre would come in and take one of us. First, there was Martin, Damien, Eltograph the Elf, and…

subject: Florian
fact: Florian is a merchant captured alongside Derrick, wearing ruined traveling clothes, and provides no further information beyond their origin and fate.
source_quote: My name is Derrick, and this is Florian. We’re originally from Norwell. Brigands captured us along the road to Hommlet.

subject: Ogre
fact: The Ogre is a hostile creature that consumes prisoners daily, guards a storeroom, and attacks the party upon encounter, wielding a club that inflicts severe damage.
source_quote: Standing at the now-open eastern door is an ogre. “You are not members of the temple! You are food!” And it swings it’s club. And boy do Ogre clubs hurt.

subject: Spugnoir
fact: Spugnoir is a magic user who is pleased when the cleric is absent, knows tales of the Circle of Eight, and accompanies the party to the tower near Emiry Meadows.
source_quote: So, any interest in that tower? ... “There was a great battle here some years ago. I must tell you one of the most intriguing elements of that battle.”

subject: Jaroo
fact: Jaroo is the village druid who listens to the party’s reports, urges caution, and agrees to present evidence to the Village Elders.
source_quote: The Druid meets us in his grove, his greybeard flowing, and listens to me, but I don’t think he is convinced. “You have proof of brigands. And that is important... But you have no proof.”

subject: Burne
fact: Burne is a militia captain who commends the party for their work but avoids escalating the situation regarding the Temple of Elemental Evil.
source_quote: I want to commend our heroes for their information. I am thrilled to see them working together and that our decision to deputize them has produced such excellent information.

subject: Rufus
fact: Rufus is the captain of the militia who dismisses the party’s evidence as insufficient to warrant national attention or intervention by the arch-cleric of Verbobonc.
source_quote: You have brought strong evidence of Brigand's activity, and they must be dealt with. But we have no conclusive evidence of the re-emergence of the Temple of Elemental Evil.

subject: Ostler
fact: Ostler is the innkeeper who pays for the party’s room, expresses approval of their decision to consult the Druid first, and is subtly aligned with local power structures.
source_quote: And your room has been paid for until the 19th. ... And I am very pleased that you decided to go to Jaroo before going to those interloping outsiders.

subject: The Duke
fact: The Duke is a self-important figure who guards the prisoners after the party’s return to Hommlet and promises to help transport them back to the town.
source_quote: Don’t you worry, team. I’ll make sure to guard them. When you come back, for good, we can all take them back to Hommlet.

subject: zombies
fact: Zombies emerge from five rotten prison doors in the southern hallway, emit nonsensical sounds mistaken for “Brains!”, and are turned by Calmer’s clerical power.
source_quote: “Zombies!” ... They aren’t saying anything. But what happens is the sound that escapes from their decaying vocal cords sounds like “nsazsa,” and everyone thinks they are saying Brains!”

subject: smoke mephit
fact: A smoke mephit inhabits the tower near Emiry Meadows, demands entertainment to avoid attack, and is killed after Zephyr sings a song that enrages it.
source_quote: What concerns me is a dust and smoke mephit. The smoke mephit turns to us and says that if we entertain him, we won’t be attacked for entering his kingdom.

subject: discovery of the Ogre's repast
fact: The party discovers that six prisoners were brought to the moathouse and consumed daily by the Ogre, with two merchants and a gnome spy surviving.
source_quote: Those captured alive were brought here as a repast for the Ogre. There were six of us. Every day, the Ogre would come in and take one of us.

subject: zombie outbreak in southern hallway
fact: Five prison doors in the southern hallway release zombies, prompting a panicked retreat after the party realizes all doors contain undead.
source_quote: The other three doors also have zombies! ... “Time to get out of here,” I shout.

subject: meeting with Village Elders
fact: The party presents evidence to the Village Elders, who dismiss the threat of the Temple of Elemental Evil as insufficient for national action, and invite them to participate in the end-of-month festival.
source_quote: You have brought strong evidence of Brigand's activity... but not worthy of disrupting the arch-cleric of Verbobonc. ... You are invited, of course.

subject: visit to the tower near Emiry Meadows
fact: The party enters a tower near Emiry Meadows, finds a summoning circle, a mural, and a smoke mephit, and kills it after Zephyr’s ill-advised song.
source_quote: Looking inside, I see permanent markings on the floor for a summoning circle and mural. ... The smoke mephit turns to us... Zephyr tries to entertain him with some song.

subject: revelation of the Circle of Eight
fact: Spugnoir reveals that the Circle of Eight—legendary mages including Bigby, Ottiluke, and Leomund—appeared at the Battle of Emiry Meadows to bind an evil presence in the tower.
source_quote: There are tales that the circle of eight appeared. ... The Circle of Eight is neither good nor evil. They only care about the balance.

subject: Calmer’s clerical turning of zombies
fact: Calmer successfully turns the zombies in the southern hallway, buying the party a minute to investigate before fleeing.
source_quote: I wonder if Calmer has any power over the undead! And yes, he does! They are turned. We have about a minute to check out what’s here.

subject: Jarran’s offer to join
fact: The gnome spy Jarran offers to accompany the party if they promise to keep exploring, but is declined due to distrust.
source_quote: Although, if you need another sword and promise to keep exploring, I could stick around. ... No, I don’t think that’s necessary.

subject: festival invitation
fact: The Village Elders invite the party to participate in the end-of-month community festival, including decorating and location committee duties.
source_quote: Every month, we celebrate another month as a community. We wish people a happy birthday, celebrate any newborn, and mourn any deaths. ... Could you help with decorating? And could you participate in the location committee?

subject: Spugnoir’s presence at the tower
fact: Spugnoir accompanies the party to the tower, identifies the summoning circle, and contributes knowledge of the Circle of Eight, but remains passive during combat.
source_quote: Spugnoir, peaking over my shoulder, says, “It contains the formula for a magic circle.” ... “There was a great battle here some years ago...”

subject: Village Elder's house
fact: The Village Elder's house is the site of a formal meeting where the party presents evidence, faces bureaucratic dismissal, and is invited to a festival.
source_quote: I will be in the Village Elder's house—the same room where we met with him last time.

subject: Inn of the Welcome Wench
fact: The Inn of the Welcome Wench is where the party returns to Hommlet, where Spugnoir is pleased by the cleric’s absence and Ostler pays for their room.
source_quote: So when we walk into the Inn of the Welcome Wench, the magic user Spugnoir seems particularly pleased that the cleric is not with us.

subject: Druid’s grove
fact: The Druid’s grove is where the party first presents their findings to Jaroo, who urges caution and agrees to bring the matter to the Village Elders.
source_quote: The Druid meets us in his grove, his greybeard flowing, and listens to me...

subject: Emiry Meadows
fact: Emiry Meadows is the site of a past battle where the Circle of Eight appeared and where the tower with the summoning circle is located.
source_quote: The tower that the mage promised is more of a single building. It's not quite at the Battle of Emiry Meadows but near the battle of Emiry Meadows.

subject: purple robe
fact: Derrick, one of the captured merchants, wears a strange purple robe, suggesting possible magical or noble affiliation.
source_quote: One of them, wearing a strange purple robe, says, “My name is Derrick...”

subject: Eltograph the Elf
fact: Eltograph the Elf was one of the six prisoners consumed by the Ogre, and his magical cloak was later found in the Ogre’s nest.
source_quote: First, there was Martin, Damien, Eltograph the Elf, and…

subject: dust mephit
fact: A dust mephit is present alongside the smoke mephit in the tower, though only the smoke mephit is directly interacted with.
source_quote: What concerns me is a dust and smoke mephit.

subject: Calmer’s failed healing attempt
fact: Calmer offers to help Derrick during his emotional breakdown, but is rebuffed due to his history of inappropriate interference.
source_quote: “I can help?” shouts Calmer. And I think, the last time he helped, he started berating someone about their life choices. “No, I think I can handle this.”

subject: departure from moathouse
fact: The party escapes the moathouse after confronting the Ogre, zombies, and discovering prisoners, returning to Hommlet with survivors and artifacts.
source_quote: A few minutes later, we’re standing in front of the Duke, who is giving out food and talking to the merchants.

subject: opening of southern door
fact: The party opens the heavily barred southern door, revealing the prison cells that contained the zombies and the Ogre’s victims.
source_quote: And why is that door to the south so heavily barred? Calmer, who has recovered from being attacked by an ogre, and I clear the door.

subject: Jaroo’s agreement to present evidence
fact: Jaroo agrees to present the party’s evidence to the Village Elders the next day, marking the first official step toward institutional response.
source_quote: “Tomorrow then. We will meet at the Village Elder,” says Jaroo.

subject: Zinia’s decision to enter tower first
fact: Zinia draws the straw to enter the tower first, demonstrating leadership and risk-taking despite Spugnoir’s caution.
source_quote: Straws are drawn, and I am going to enter first. The mage is as far back as possible.

subject: Zephyr’s song inciting mephit
fact: Zephyr sings a song about the sea, rain, and clear day after fire, which enrages the smoke mephit and triggers combat.
source_quote: Zephyr tries to entertain him with some song. Unfortunately, as we learn later, that song is a song that immediately induces a blood-curdling rage in smoke and dust mephits.

subject: Calmer’s dismissal from Village Elder meeting
fact: Calmer attempts to derail the Village Elder meeting by demanding the Prefect’s presence, but is shut down by Sequoia for being off-topic.
source_quote: “I would like to insist that the Prefect be present for these meetings.” ... “I don’t have time for this. Calmer, this is not the topic of the meeting.”

subject: Spugnoir’s writing at the inn
fact: Spugnoir is seen writing at his table in the Inn of the Welcome Wench, suggesting he is documenting the party’s activities or compiling his own research.
source_quote: He smiles and heads back to his table, where he seems busy writing stuff.

subject: Ostler’s whisper about Jaroo
fact: Ostler whispers to Zinia that he is pleased she consulted Jaroo before outsiders, indicating local political alignment with the Druid’s authority.
source_quote: And I am very pleased that you decided to go to Jaroo before going to those interloping outsiders.

subject: departure from Village Elder house
fact: The party leaves the Village Elder house after being invited to the festival, with Sequoia and Zinia fleeing to avoid further obligations.
source_quote: Sequoia looks at me and Jaroo and says, “Gotta go!”

subject: Zephyr’s reaction to the Village Elder meeting
fact: Zephyr describes the Village Elder meeting as worse than the Abyss, and is relieved when Sequoia and Zinia flee.
source_quote: I’ve seen the abyss. And let me assure you, the Abyss is not appreciably worse than that meeting.
